name: WPRTS
recent: Westports 在 2026 年 10 月 21 日公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日的季度业绩，营收与净利均同比增长。同期，KWAP 在 9 月至 11 月间多次申报其作为大股东的持股变动。
notable: 截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日的季度净利同比增长 47.9% 至约 RM342.6 million。
KWAP 在 2026 年 9 月至 11 月间多次就持股变动提交大股东权益申报。
earnings: 2026 年第三季营收为 RM1,068.39 million，同比增长 54.6%，环比增长 23.2%；净利为 RM342.56 million，同比增长 47.9%，环比下降 5.1%；净利率为 32.1%，低于上一季度的 41.6%。

recent_en: Westports released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 21 October 2026, with revenue and net profit both rising year-on-year. Meanwhile, KWAP filed multiple substantial shareholder notices between September and November.
notable_en: Net profit for the quarter ended 30 September 2026 rose 47.9% year-on-year to about RM342.6 million.
KWAP filed multiple substantial shareholder notices on changes in its shareholding between September and November 2026.
earnings_en: Q3 2026 revenue was RM1,068.39 million, up 54.6% year-on-year and 23.2% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was RM342.56 million, up 47.9% year-on-year but down 5.1% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 32.1%, lower than 41.6% in the previous quarter.
